The MACD histogram is worsening at -6.3017, indicating a bearish convergence. ADX at 28.7 suggests a clear trend, but the -DI is significantly higher than the +DI, indicating downward pressure dominance. Weekly RSI is at 40.8, in bearish territory, and down -11.27% from the weekly SMA20. The 4-hour RSI is at 33.3, also in oversold territory. The current price is at 49.2% of its 52-week high, near neutral, but short-term indicators suggest downward pressure.
